versions.content: Service Name Csm_ Job Key Set Invalid Syntax Std_ Return Type Csm_ Job Key Set Invalid ( uint32 job Id, uint32 key Id ) Service ID [hex] 0x84 Sync/ Async Synchronous or Async, depending on the job configuration Reentrancy Reentrant Parameters (in) job Id Holds the identifier of the job using the CSM service. key Id Holds the identifier of the key which shall be invalidated. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std _ Return Type E_ OK: Request successful E_ NOT_ OK: Request fail ed CRYPTO_ E_ BUSY: Request failed, Crypro Driver Object is busy Description Sets the key status to invalid. The key cannot be used any longer for cryptographic operations until it has been set to valid state again. Available via Csm.h
